rawLevel: Exercise a high degree of caution
summary: Indonesia is under an advisory to exercise a high degree of caution due to political and social tensions and the threat of terrorism throughout the country. Specific regions with higher warnings include all provinces of Indonesian Papua (except Raja Ampat Regency and Sorong city) due to violent incidents, threats from militant groups, and kidnapping risks, as well as Aceh province and East and West Kalimantan due to kidnapping threats.

rawLevel: Exercise a high degree of caution
summary: Thailand is under a general advisory of exercising a high degree of caution due to ongoing political tensions, sporadic demonstrations, and a persistent terrorism threat. Specific regions face higher warnings: the Thailand-Cambodia border area (within 50 km) is under 'Avoid all travel' due to border disputes and armed clashes, and the southern provinces of Narathiwat, Pattani, Yala, and southern Songkhla (including Hat Yai city and areas east of Highways 408 and 4113) are also under 'Avoid all travel' due to violent separatist insurgent attacks.

rawLevel: Exercise a high degree of caution
summary: The Government of Canada advises Canadians to exercise a high degree of caution in Türkiye due to the threat of terrorist attacks and the possibility of demonstrations throughout the country. Specific regions with higher warnings include areas within 10 km of the borders with Iraq and Syria (avoid all travel) and the southeastern provinces of Hakkari and Şirnak (avoid non-essential travel) due to the unpredictable security situation and terrorism threats.

rawLevel: Exercise a high degree of caution
summary: The Government of Canada advises Canadians to exercise a high degree of caution in Egypt overall due to ongoing tensions in the region, an unpredictable security situation, and the threat of terrorism. Specific regions with higher warnings include Northern Sinai (avoid all travel due to terrorist activity and military operations), the Western Desert and Libyan border area (avoid all travel due to smuggling, terrorist activities, and armed groups), and the northern part of South Sinai (avoid non-essential travel due to terrorism).

The Government of Canada advises Canadians to avoid non-essential travel to Kuwait due to the volatile security situation in the region, including missile and drone attacks striking targets in Kuwait. There is an ongoing threat of terrorism, particularly at or near foreign military installations and places of worship. The border area with Iraq, specifically within 5 km of the border, is under a higher advisory level of 'Avoid all travel' due to unexploded ordnance from the 1991 Gulf War.

Avoid non-essential travel to Israel due to the volatile security situation in the region, including ongoing military activity, terrorism, and potential travel disruptions. Specific areas with higher warnings include Jerusalem (avoid non-essential travel), the Golan Heights border with Syria (avoid all travel), the area within 5 km of the Lebanon border (avoid all travel), and the area within 10 km of the Gaza Strip border (avoid all travel).
